newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices stead on low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices stead on low volumes.

text.p: Indian soybean prices were steady in central Indian markets on Friday on low volumes and limited trade, dealers said.
Arrivals were around 4,000 tonnes on Friday against 20,000 tonnes in the same period last year. Business volumes were dull and undertone steady.
Soyoil prices were unchanged while soymeal prices were slightly up on limited supply. Soymeal yellow was $271-272 per tonne in export.
Rapeseed extraction prices were steady. Rapeseed extraction was $132-133 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,500 rupees FOR Bedibunder and was 4,475 rupees FOR Bhavnagar.
